page_weight.method: GET of the page and of the same-origin stylesheets, scripts, fonts, images, icons and manifest it references (with the stylesheets' url() and @import), each once, with Accept-Encoding: zstd, br, gzip; bytes are response bodies as served, without headers. The repeat visit reuses a response while Cache-Control max-age (or Expires) keeps it fresh, revalidates it with If-None-Match or If-Modified-Since when it has a validator, and fetches it again otherwise.

production.reason: pass --monitor-url to read what the app served in production

sci_estimate.label: estimate
sci_estimate.energy_method: E = measured app CPU time × --cpu-watts (your power figure per busy CPU second), plus the network term when --network-kwh-per-gb is given
sci_estimate.network_method: E_network = measured response body bytes ÷ 10^9 × --network-kwh-per-gb (your energy figure per gigabyte transferred)
sci_estimate.functional_unit: one HTTP request; R = requests completed in the benchmark

notes: Only the page weight was measured: footprint fetched the published site's page and same-origin resources, and measured no binary, memory, start-up, CPU or dependency figure.

Page bytes are response bodies as the site sent them to this machine, compressed as served, without headers; a visitor elsewhere, a CDN cache in another state, cookies or a signed-in session can receive different bytes.
This report is a measurement, not a certification, an environmental claim or a comparison with other software; if you publish these figures, you are responsible for how you word them.
